notes: Stories refined for contract completeness, status normalization, and tighter integration with ClinicalTrials.gov response patterns.

change_log.value: Expanded schema to include raw_status, normalized_status, score, and explanation fields for downstream explainability.
change_log.note: Ensure contract supports normalization + UX explainability

change_log.value: Enhanced logic to normalize ClinicalTrials.gov statuses (e.g., RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, UNKNOWN) and map to scores with deterministic rules.
change_log.note: Align with real API status values from service

change_log.value: Clarified integration to ensure recruitment score is included in trial objects returned by evaluate_care_facade alongside existing trial metadata.
Expanded tests to include parameterized cases for all known statuses and normalization edge cases.
Extended integration test to validate full flow from ClinicalTrials.gov fetch through normalization, scoring, and API response payload.

stories.title: Define Recruitment Status Score Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define normalized schema for clinical trial recruitment status scoring including raw_status, normalized_status (RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, UNKNOWN), numeric score, and human-readable explanation field for downstream consumers.

stories.title: Implement Recruitment Status Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to normalize ClinicalTrials.gov recruitment statuses and assign scores (e.g., RECRUITING = highest, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING = medium-high, COMPLETED = medium, TERMINATED/WITHDRAWN = lowest). Include deterministic mapping and handling for null, unknown, or unexpected values.

stories.title: Expose Recruitment Status Score via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate recruitment status scoring into clinical trial objects and expose via evaluate_care_facade so each trial response includes normalized status, score, and explanation alongside existing metadata.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Recruitment Status Scoring
stories.description: Create parameterized unit tests validating normalization and score assignment across all known recruitment statuses and edge cases (unknown, null, unexpected values).

stories.title: Integration Test for Recruitment Status in Trial Evaluation Flow
stories.description: Validate end-to-end flow ensuring recruitment status is fetched from ClinicalTrials.gov, normalized, scored, and correctly returned in evaluate_care_facade responses.
